title: Assistant Professor of Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School
bio: Faculty Assistant Professor of Surgery, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School Education PhD, University of Rochester Education PhD, University of Rochester Amy Tsurumi is an assistant professor at the Massachusetts General Hospital/Harvard Medical School, where she studies epigenetic and gene regulatory mechanisms in infections and aging. She received her PhD in genetics at the University of Rochester School of Medicine and Dentistry and her master’s in epidemiology at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.
